description: This script performs setup and test procedures for a Git repository involving submodules, including creating commits, adding files, and listing revisions. It is used for testing 'git rev-list' behavior with submodules.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp to simulate progression between commits.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Stages files for commit in the Git repository.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Records the current state of the index to the repository with a message.

methods.name: git rev-list
methods.description: Lists commit objects in a revision range, used here to analyze commit history involving submodules.

methods.name: git symbolic-ref
methods.description: Updates the symbolic reference for HEAD to a specific branch.

methods.name: git -c protocol.file.allow=always submodule add
methods.description: Adds a submodule to the repository with configuration to allow protocol.
